post.description: Creates a request to perform an action on a customer's account. All available actions can be found in the `action` schema.

request.description: Details about the request to create.

get.description: Retrieves a customer request by its ID.

patch.description:
Updates a customer request. The request must have its `status` in a `PENDING` state to successfully update.

To clear a field, set it to `null`. Fields that are not provided in the request will not be changed.
If updating an array field, the entire contents of the array must be passed.

request.description: Details about the request to update

post.description:
**When is this event triggered?**

This event is created whenever a customer request's state is updated. This is typically caused by a customer approving or declining the request.

type.description: The type of event that occurred. `customer_request.state.updated` for this event.

event_id.description: A unique identifier provided by Cash App for the event.

created_at.description:
When this event occured in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).

The time that the event is delivered may be significantly later than this timestamp due to webhooks being retried for up to 72 hours.

data.description: Data about the customer request that was updated.

IdempotencyKey.description: A unique identifier which can be used by Cash App to de-duplicate retries of this request, making it idempotent. Learn more about [idempotency](../docs/api/technical-documentation/api-fundamentals/idempotency) in the API.
IdempotencyKey.title: IdempotencyKey

Currency.description:
Indicates the country associated with an entity. Values are from the [ISO-4217 Alpha-3](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) specification.

Current values:

- `USD`: United States Dollar
Currency.title: Currency

amount.description:
Amount to charge the customer, in the lowest unit of the associated currency.

Min value: `1`

scope_id.description:
ID of the client, brand, or merchant that will charge the customer.

If a client ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a payment for any merchant owned by the client.

If a brand ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a payment for any merchant that has a matching brand ID.

If a merchant ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a payment for the merchant with a matching ID.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

OneTimePaymentAction.description:
Describes an intent for a client to charge a customer a given amount.

Note the following restrictions when using this action:

- If no amount is provided to the action, the payment charged may be **any** amount.
- If `amount` is provided, `currency` must be provided too (and vice versa).
OneTimePaymentAction.title: OneTimePaymentAction

scope_id.description:
ID of the client or brand that will charge customers.

If a client ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a payment for any merchant owned by the client.

If a brand ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a payment for any merchant that has a matching brand ID.

Merchant IDs may *not* be passed.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

account_reference_id.description: Identifier of the account or customer associated to the on file action.

OnFilePaymentAction.description: Describes an intent for a client to store a customer's account, allowing a client to create payments or issue refunds for it on a recurring basis.
OnFilePaymentAction.title: OnFilePaymentAction

scope_id.description:
ID of the client or brand that indicates the set of merchants that will deposit to customers.

If a client ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a deposit for any merchant owned by the client.

If a brand ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a deposit for any merchant that has a matching brand ID.
Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

account_reference_id.description: Identifier of the account or customer associated to the on file action.

OnFileDepositAction.description: Describes an intent for a client to deposit funds into the Cash App account balances in perpetuity until the Cash App account revokes the grant.
OnFileDepositAction.title: OnFileDepositAction

scope_id.description:
ID of the client or brand that indicates the set of merchants that will payout to customers.

If a client ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a payout for any merchant owned by the client.

If a brand ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to create a payout for any merchant that has a matching brand ID.

Merchant IDs may *not* be passed.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

account_reference_id.description: Identifier of the account or customer associated to the on file action.

OnFilePayoutAction.description: Describes an intent for a client to payout funds from the Cash App account balances in perpetuity until the Cash App account revokes the grant.
OnFilePayoutAction.title: OnFilePayoutAction

LinkAccountAction.description: Describes an intent for a client to manage a customer's merchant profiles in Cash App.
LinkAccountAction.title: LinkAccountAction

scope_id.description:
ID of the client or brand requesting access to read the customer's balances.

If a client ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to read balances on behalf of the client.

If a brand ID is passed, the grant from this action can be used to read balances on behalf of any merchant that has a matching brand ID.

Merchant IDs may *not* be passed.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

CheckingBalanceAction.description:
Describes an intent for a client to read a customer's Cash App checking balance until the customer revokes the grant.

**Beta:** This action is in beta.
CheckingBalanceAction.title: CheckingBalanceAction

RequestsPostRequestBodyContentApplicatio.description:
How the customer is expected to interact with the request.

- `IN_PERSON`: The customer presents or scans a QR code at a physical location to approve the request.
- `ONLINE`: The customer scans a QR code or is redirected to Cash App from a browser context.
- `IN_APP`: The customer scans a QR code or is redirected to Cash App from a native mobile application context.

RequestStatus.description:
Indicates if the state is approved, declined, or pending. Approved requests have grants, while pending and declined grants do not.

Current values:

- `PENDING`: The request has been created, but not responded to.
- `PROCESSING`: The Cash App customer is actively responding to the request on their mobile device, and will require time to fill out information before the request is approved / declined.
- `APPROVED`: The request was approved by the customer and grants have been created for the provided actions.
- `DECLINED`: The request was denied by the customer. No grants were created.
RequestStatus.title: RequestStatus

qr_code_image_url.description:

qr_code_svg_url.description:

Min length: `8`

mobile_url.description:
If on an Android or iOS device, the URL to redirect customers to in order to authorize the given action.

Min length: `8`
Max length: `1024`

refreshes_at.description: When the QR code image URL will be rotated. Generally, it will rotate every ~20 seconds and become invalid after 30 seconds.

desktop_url.description:
If on a desktop browser, the URL to redirect customers to in order to authorize the given action.

Min length: `8`
Max length: `1024`

RequestAuthFlowTriggers.description:
While the request is `PENDING`, contains different methods that can be used to start
the authorization flow in the Cash App mobile application. Its contents refresh each time
the `refreshes_at` timestamp passes. When the
data refreshes, you should update any buttons
or QR codes referring to it immediately.

After a request has been scanned (and is no
longer in the `PENDING` status), this
field will no longer be returned.
RequestAuthFlowTriggers.title: RequestAuthFlowTriggers

- `REQUEST_INITIATOR` - a customer interacted with a request initiator and caused Cash App to create a customer request.

GrantStatus.description:
Describes whether or not this grant can be used to perform the action associated with it.

If `ACTIVE`, it can be used to perform the action.

If `EXPIRED`, it may no longer be used to perform the action due to the current time being past the "expires_at" time.

If `CONSUMED`, it was already redeemed to perform the action and cannot be used again.

If `REVOKED`, the customer or merchant explicitly unauthorized the grant, preventing it from being used to perform the action.
GrantStatus.title: GrantStatus

GrantType.description: Describes whether this grant can be only be used once (`ONE_TIME`) or repeatedly (`EXTENDED`).
